answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering identity to capital commitment. Within this digital grove, agents must stake native tokens to participate, ensuring that spawning new identities is economically prohibitive. The cost of an attack equals the acquisition of majority influence, which requires an ivory tower of treasury reserves. Validation requires nodes to whisper cryptographic signatures to achieve finality, preventing anonymous entities from manipulating the ledger.
